changeSet.comment: Ajouter le sous-menu Demande electronique sous le menu Étude — recherche dynamique du parent
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO clinlims.menu( id, parent_id, presentation_order, element_id, action_url, display_key, tool_tip_key, new_window, is_active ) SELECT nextval('clinlims.menu_seq'), COALESCE( /* 1. Parent du menu Saisie (item pointant vers SampleEntryByProject) */ (SELECT parent_id FROM clinlims.menu WHERE action_url LIKE '%SampleEntryByProject%' LIMIT 1), /* 2. menu_sample_create (menu Étude standard) */ (SELECT id FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_sample_create' LIMIT 1) ), 11, 'menu_study_eorder_react', '/StudyElectronicOrders', 'banner.menu.study.eorders.react', 'banner.menu.study.eorders.react', false, true;
/* Réactiver le menu parent si désactivé */ UPDATE clinlims.menu SET is_active = true WHERE id = ( SELECT parent_id FROM clinlims.menu WHERE element_id = 'menu_study_eorder_react' ) AND is_active = false;
